preconditions.description: The number of towns n must be between 3 and 100,000.
The number of monasteries m must be at least 2 and less than the number of towns n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= monastery <= n for monastery in monasteries)
preconditions.description: All monastery indices must be within the range of town indices.
The number of edges must be exactly n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n and 1 <= ci <= 1000 for ai, bi, ci in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect valid town indices and have a positive length.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum number of unhappy pilgrims followed by the number of ways to achieve this.
The maximum number of unhappy pilgrims must be non-negative.
The number of ways to make pilgrims unhappy must be non-negative.
